title: An executable Maven WAR advertises its embedded SBOM
summary: Checks the format, physical WAR location and actual SBOM bytes, with a differently located CycloneDX filename encountered first.

subject.symbol: Repackager.repackage → JarFile manifest and named entry

change.description: The shared packager now recognizes CycloneDX filenames below a layout’s classes directory. An executable Maven WAR can advertise the SBOM already packaged under `WEB-INF/classes`.

notes: The numbered caller checks the original shared Repackager. A separate Apache Maven 3.9.13 run built two WARs with each original Boot plugin. The parent manifests omitted both attributes. The merged manifests selected the original CycloneDX bytes, including when the physical decoy came first in both input and output. [Parent Maven builds](../../verification/merged-pr-links/s01-s50/maven-war/parent.json) · [Merged Maven builds](../../verification/merged-pr-links/s01-s50/maven-war/fix.json)
